title: Build a JSONL-to-Markdown handoff CLI
outcome: Create a small dependency-free Python CLI that turns a JSONL stream of software-work events into a concise Markdown handoff that preserves evidence and unknowns.

acceptance.criterion: A documented command reads a JSONL file and writes a Markdown handoff.
The output separates outcome, evidence, and unknowns.
Malformed input fails clearly with a non-zero exit status and no traceback.
Automated tests cover the successful path, malformed input, and preservation of unknown values.
GitHub Actions runs the tests on the pull-request head.
The pull request explains the result, verification, limitations, and rollback.

allowed_effects: create or update one Issue in the named private canary repository
write synthetic repository files and commits on that branch
open or update one pull request
respond to CI and review evidence without merging
forbidden_effects: change repository or organization settings, permissions, secrets, or rulesets
